statement: The five-compound 3x3x3 MACE barrier panel satisfies the Hard Materials Z1 barrier-accuracy acceptance test (MAE <= 40 meV).

premises.statement: The content-addressed five-compound 3x3x3 barrier panel reports a 77.12788034654477 meV MAE against the cited experimental references, above the 40 meV Z1 ceiling.

lean_theorem.reason: BarrierArrhenius theorems formalize consequences of barrier error; they do not prove the empirical five-compound aggregate MAE.

runtime_gate.reason: No deployed runtime gate consumes the Hard Materials Z1 aggregate barrier-accuracy measurement.

excluded_scope: Barrier accuracy for models other than mace-mp-medium
Structures or chemistries outside the five rocksalt halides
Charged-defect corrections, finite-temperature prefactors, diffusivities, and Arrhenius rates
